prompt: A giant dinosaur fossil pressed flat into a quarry slab, viewed straight on. The skeleton is locked in the extreme opisthotonus death pose: the skull and long neck are bent all the way backward until they almost touch the hips, the spine recurved into a tight C-shape, the long tail sweeping up and over in a matching curve, forming an almost coiled crescent of bone like the famous arched Coelophysis and Compsognathus fossils. It is a FLAT petrified imprint pressed sideways into a single slab of grey slate, every bone a dark stone silhouette at the same level as the rock, NOT three-dimensional, NOT standing. Layered rock strata. A cold blue-white necromantic glow traces a mineral seam through the slab. Dark mine quarry, colorless earthen palette.
